A1.justification: Both 38-page PDFs describe the same research work and contain readable main text, equations, algorithms, figures and Appendices A–L. The material supports reliable comparison across figure renumbering and text reflow.

before.justification: v1 reports original mathematical-reasoning and toxicity-avoidance experiments, including baseline comparisons, transfer tests and robustness analyses in Section 6 and the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results, including selective accuracy, reward, token savings, transfer and robustness findings.

M1.justification: Dynamic value-thresholding, the hidden-state MLP estimator, binary cross-entropy training and inference procedures remain unchanged. Sections 3 and 5 and Algorithms 1–2 specify the same method.

E1.justification: Both retain GSM8K and OlympiadBench mathematical reasoning, cross-dataset transfer, and RealToxicityPrompts toxicity avoidance. No training or evaluation domain, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Constant Step Probe, Self-Assessment, LoRA Abstention and no abstention remain the comparators. The same three abstention baselines participate at input and fixed positions for mathematics and at input only for toxicity.

E3.justification: Model configurations, splits, training budgets, fixed-position cutoffs, isotonic calibration and testing procedures are unchanged. Appendix L retains 500 training and 500 test prompts for toxicity.

E4.justification: Transfer, threshold stability, abstention timing, monotone transformations, Gaussian-noise robustness and abstention precision analyses are retained. The new introductory schematic illustrates the method without adding an empirical case study.

E5.justification: Both report five probe-retraining seeds, 42–46, with shaded regions showing one standard deviation. Appendix E retains 20 random calibration/test splits per seed.

E6.justification: All twelve original empirical plot images are identical, becoming Figures 2–13 in v4. Numerical findings also match, including Phi-3 OlympiadBench accuracy of 0.64 at 90% abstention and a non-toxic response rate of 1.00 at 30% abstention.

T1.justification: The MDP definitions, theoretical guarantees, assumptions and Appendix B proofs are unchanged, including the binary cross-entropy and mean-squared-error recovery arguments. The changed Bellman citation does not alter mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and discussion retain the same contributions: formalizing dynamic abstention, establishing dominance and conditional optimality, estimating values efficiently, and demonstrating empirical benefits.

C2.justification: Some result commentary is shortened, but interpretations of transfer, ranking robustness and fixed-position limitations remain in the main text and appendices. Section 7 retains the same applicability limits and future directions.

D1.justification: v4 adds a code-repository hyperlink at the end of the introduction; v1 provides none. Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware descriptions and training times otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 5 newly credits five earlier works for related value-estimation ideas. Appendix A.1 adds Bonagiri et al. (2025) on agentic quitting, and Bellman (1966) is replaced by Bellman (1952). These are focused attribution and positioning updates.

P1.justification: v4 makes localized wording edits and compresses explanations in Sections 3, 5 and 6. It also updates the publication footer and expands acknowledgments and funding disclosures; section and appendix organization remain stable.

P2.justification: v4 adds Figure 1, a first-page schematic showing threshold crossing, abstention and saved tokens. The twelve existing empirical figures retain their content, with renumbering and limited accompanying page reflow.

improvement.justification: The new schematic makes the stopping rule easier to understand, added citations improve attribution, and the repository pointer improves code-access guidance. These provide a modest quality gain while the methods, proofs and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
